title: rostellaria diffusa
intro: Rostellaria diffusa, commonly known as the "Milk Purifier," is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and rheumatism. The health benefits of Rostellaria diffusa include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory issues, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties.
